conditions: Data about the user's age must be transmitted to the SDK every time the application starts.
effects: Restricts the collection of information from children under the age of 13.

conditions: User is under the age of 13
effects: The SDK will adhere to COPPA regulations regarding the collection of personal data from children.

conditions: User is 13 years old or older
effects: The SDK will not restrict the collection of user information based on age.

conditions: The user's consent for processing personal data must be sent to the SDK each time the application is launched.
effects: Data of users located in the GDPR region will be processed only if the user consents to data processing.

conditions: User provides consent for data processing
effects: User data can be processed by the SDK in compliance with GDPR.

conditions: User does not provide consent for data processing
effects: User data will not be processed by the SDK until consent is obtained.

conditions: Enable AppMetrica SDK version 3.14.3 or higher.
effects: The SDK automatically considers the app context to select more relevant ads.

conditions: Automatic tracking of contextual app data is enabled.
effects: The SDK tracks and uses contextual data to select relevant ads.

conditions: Automatic accounting for contextual data is disabled.
effects: The SDK does not track contextual data, which may reduce ad relevance.
